mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 8% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 2% over three months signals a monetary policy tightening in a high-inflation environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 2% and CPIAUCSL rises above 2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month over six months signals robust labor market expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 for six consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 96 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing output, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 96 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO is below 96 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 13,500 for three consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 13,500 for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly increases in GDPC1 above 13,500 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the federal funds rate and CPI inflation below 1% over three months signals a monetary policy easing in a low-inflation environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 1% and CPIAUCSL falls below 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are below 1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
